prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured is represented by other counsel or has retained an adjuster, please let us know so we can coordinate appropriately.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that applies to this loss, together with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may be available. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this file.

Our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation, and we expect to present a full accounting of damages once treatment and records are complete. In the meantime, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.
